retired_at.description: When it was retired; null while active.

updated_by.description: Who made the last write (the create, else the last edit).

version.description: Send it back as the PATCH precondition.

CharacterCreate.description: Request body of `POST /api/admin/members/{id}/characters`. `ign` is 4-12 letters or digits, unique per `world` case-insensitively (retired characters included; else 422 `ign_taken`); `world` is the region, default `msea`; `class` is at most 32 characters (empty: none); `level` 1-300. A member's first active character is their main whatever `role` says; otherwise `role` defaults to `alt`, and `main` takes the crown (the current main becomes an alt in the same write).

CharacterPatch.description: Request body of `PATCH /api/admin/characters/{id}`. `version` is the row version the edit was made from (else 422 `version_required`; another version is 409 `stale`). An omitted field is kept; `class`/`level` `null` (or an empty class) clears it; `retired: true` retires (keeping the first time), `false` restores. `role: main` takes the crown; without `role`, an active character with no other active main becomes the main and a restored main becomes an alt while another main is active. The main cannot be retired or made an alt while the member has other active characters (409 `main_required`).
